world_bible.name: Neo-Geneva Quarantine
world_bible.premise: In 2080, the sealed city of Neo-Geneva depends on MNEMOS facial identity infrastructure. FHD-80 destroys human facial familiarity while the machines continue to recognize everyone, turning identity itself into the city's most contested resource.

locations.name: Red Line Transit and Service Tunnels

rules.description: FHD-80 is a fictional neuroinvasive disease, not a zombie agent; infected people retain personhood and moral agency until severe delirium or coma.
Prosopagnosia removes recognition, not visual detail. Faces do not melt, blur or physically change inside the story world.
Symptoms follow four tracked windows: days 1-4 systemic illness and anosmia; 5-7 facial and spatial recognition failure; 8-12 encephalitis and autonomic instability; 13-22 terminal risk.
Voice, gait, personal objects, phrases and shared behavior can support identity verification, but none is individually infallible.
MAB-TJ can interrupt early neuroinvasion but supply is scarce; late ADEX-R treatment can preserve life while risking permanent autobiographical memory loss.
MNEMOS authenticates registered bodies but cannot judge consent, loyalty, love or moral truth; privileged insiders can corrupt its records only with auditable access.
The setting contains advanced biotechnology and surveillance but no magic, resurrection, teleportation or supernatural memory powers.
Death is irreversible and evidence left by the dead cannot answer new questions.
